pass: B — canonicalisation. FROZEN. Pass C classifies against this list and nothing else.
what: One controlled vocabulary of relational predicaments, judged and merged from three independently-built proposals over the same 1,538 Pass A predicaments (300 films, 296 scoring).

why: It is the only proposal that measured what Pass C actually does. Pass C is CLASSIFICATION, not generation. propB re-tagged 240 predicaments against its own frozen list in different company and a different group size and reproduced 84.6% (92.5% where both passes named a predicate), and ran a blind precision audit that accepted 88.3% of 120 real tags and 0 of 60 randomly-swapped decoys. propA and propC measured their vocabularies; only propB measured the act Pass C will perform. Against Pass A generation reproducibility of 1.2-4.2%, that number is the whole justification for spending Pass C.

Its unit is the only one that is strictly a relation: identity = (agent role) --act--> (patient role), with subject matter, era, country AND OUTCOME stripped. Excluding outcome from identity is what makes rebuttals fall out rather than be hunted for — if bond-severed had split into -restored/-fatal, no two films could ever disagree on it.

Lowest batch artefact of the three: 2.89% of its co-occurring pairs are batch-mates against 1.63% at chance (1.77x), where exact-phrase co-occurrence puts 97.1% there (59.6x). propA is 5.08% (3.1x), propC 3.53% (2.2x).

Least topically confounded of the three on an independent size-matched permutation test (see reachControl below): propA is 80.46% strictly-unreachable against a null of 83.76 with 0 of 500 permutations at or below it; propB is 82.60 (3 of 500), propC 82.47 (8 of 500). propA groups films that the atlas can already reach, which is the failure mode the layer exists to avoid.
whatItLost: 95 predicates, below the proposal's 120-250, and 10 of them above the 8% band on 300 films — rival-claims-on-one alone held 43 films (14.5%), which is the love triangle, a genre by the proposal's own definition. propB said so itself in its honestProblems. Those 10 are the entries this merge repaired.

howThisWasMerged.spine: 83 of propB's 95 kept unchanged (its 84 in-band entries minus made-thing-confronts-maker, replaced below).
howThisWasMerged.splits: All 10 propB entries above the 8% band were dropped and replaced by 34 finer entries drawn from propA and propC whose members fall inside the parent. Each child records splitFrom.
howThisWasMerged.grafts: 58 entries from propC (19) and propA (39) whose member sets have best Jaccard < 0.15 against every propB entry — that is, situations propB has no word for at all.
howThisWasMerged.cuts: 2 propB entries, plus every propA and propC entry that duplicated a kept entry or named a topic, a state or a plot mechanism rather than a relation between two parties. Reasons are recorded per id in cutRegister.
howThisWasMerged.dedupe: Every pair of kept entries was checked for member-set Jaccard. Three pairs were cut as duplicates (rivals-for-the-same-person, beloved-already-bound, marriage-arranged-over-the-woman). Three pairs at 0.34-0.37 were kept apart deliberately and carry a watch flag.
howThisWasMerged.nothingWasAuthored: No predicate here was written from scratch by the judge. Every label, every role pair and every member is taken verbatim from one of the three proposals, which were themselves mined from Pass A plot readings. The editorial act was selection, splitting and cutting.

reachControl.verdict: BELOW chance — the vocabulary joins films that were already more reachable than a random regrouping

tonalControl.verdict: TIGHTER than chance — the layer partly re-derives the fingerprint it exists to replace

concerns: DENSITY IS THE UNSOLVED PROBLEM AND IT IS NOT A DETAIL. 8,153 co-occurring pairs inside 300 films; the median film has 54 predicate neighbours and the worst has 109. A top six cannot be cut from 54 by predicate identity alone, and the proposal forbids the obvious cut — tonal distance must never enter the strength score, only sort what the predicate already selected. Nothing in this vocabulary provides a strength term. Phase 3 (route strength through associate.js surprise()) is not optional polish; without it Pass C produces a family, not a map.

THE LAYER IS TONALLY TIGHTER THAN CHANCE. Mean five-axis distance inside a predicate is 61.6 against a size-matched null of 65.3, 0 of 500 permutations at or below. All three proposals show this independently (61.7-62.0). It does not break the order-of-operations rule — no distance enters any score here — but it means predicate families are NOT independent of the fingerprint, so the headline promise (a predicate reaches films the temperature space buries) holds for particular pairs and not on average.

IT JOINS FILMS THAT WERE ALREADY SLIGHTLY MORE REACHABLE THAN A RANDOM REGROUPING. 81.74% of its pairs are strictly unreachable (no edge, no shared crew/cast/non-structural keyword, no common neighbour) against a null of 83.69, 0 of 500 permutations at or below. propC found this first and reported it as its own failure; it reproduces here and on all three proposals. The honest reading is narrower than propC's: 98.49% of the pairs have no edge today and that is real and useful, but predicaments and existing edges are not independent, because the corpus was assembled by connection density in the first place. This layer does not select FOR strangers; it just does not care about industry.

PREVALENCE IS MEASURED ON THE WRONG DENOMINATOR AND EVERY NUMBER HERE WILL MOVE. 175 of 175 sit in the 0.4-8% band on 296 readable cohort films, where one film is 0.34% and the floor is reached at two. At corpus scale the floor is 9 films of 2,204. 33 entries here rest on 2-4 films. Expect a material fraction to fall below the band after Pass C and be cut then — that is the correct sequence, not a failure.

THE MERGE STEP IS THE LEAST REPLICATED STEP IN THE PIPELINE. propB measured that its 11 independent induction groups proposed 317 family names and agreed on a name exactly twice. Family names do not converge on their own at any level of abstraction; convergence is manufactured by a merge. This freeze is one more unreplicated merge on top of that one. If the budget exists, the single highest-value check before Pass C is a second annotator classifying 200 Pass A predicaments against this frozen list blind, to get the inter-annotator number that no proposal has.

COVERAGE IS MEASURED ONLY ON THE READABLE 70%. 657 corpus films (29.8%) are below the 1,500-char evidence floor and can never be tagged. Those are disproportionately the films now surviving on crew and setting edges — the exact population the layer exists to fix. Measure the trial on readable and unreadable cohorts separately or the result will flatter the corpus.

THREE PAIRS SIT AT MEMBER-SET JACCARD 0.34-0.37 AND WERE KEPT APART ON JUDGEMENT: subordinate-turns-on-superior / the-made-turns-on-maker, the-wrong-person-is-blamed / the-accuser-holds-the-guilt, the-innocent-answer-for-one-mans-act / made-to-answer-for-another. If Pass C cannot hold those lines, merge them rather than tuning around them.

FOUR FILMS CARRY NOTHING AND SHOULD KEEP CARRYING NOTHING. Rabindranath Tagore, Koyaanisqatsi, Lumiere and Company and Le Quattro Volte all returned engine:null above the evidence floor. Koyaanisqatsi refused twice under two prompts. "None of these" is a first-class answer and Pass C must not be pushed to fill them.
